newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr yields close up on heavy issue plans.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr yields close up on heavy issue plans.

text.p: Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds closed higher on Tuesday as plans for heavy new issues due later this week depressed sentiment, brokers said.
Three-month CDs closed unchanged and the overnight call rate slightly fell, they said.
* 3-yr corporates close at 12.45 pct vs Monday's 12.43 pct
* Average overnight call rate at 12.21 pct vs Monday's 12.40
"I think the corporate yields will move in a narrow range around the current level for the time being," said Kim.
Three-month CD yields closed unchanged at 12.45 percent and the overnight call rate fell to an average of 12.21 percent from 12.30 percent on Monday.
The call rate was pressured by better than expected liquidity.
